notes.title: update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Patches:

Fixed issues with the inventory and storage

Fixed issue with the loot crates not always spawning items

Mechanics:

Vaulting mechanic added with a dampener for the jump

Rifle weapon wheel (hold T and select a barrel)

notes.title: Update/Patch v. 1.0
notes.notes:
Update notes:

New inventory and crafting system

New weapon firing logic and functionality

Playable intro cutscene and levels

Dynamic event trigger inside of the main menu

Enemy mimics physical hit reactions and animations

Removal of loading screens for a more immersive feeling and open-world

Audio editing and sound adjustments

Dynamic crosshairs

Dodge system implemented using left-alt

Fixed bloater bug where they can affect players before exploding

An immense amount of additional AI added per day

New death animations and logic

Performance optimization

Dynamic blood splatter

New bullet surface impact effects and sounds

New dismemberment sounds

notes.title: Patches/update notes
notes.notes: work on new intro cinematic (has yet to be implemented), work on new ui textures/materials to look pixelated (part of actual helmet screen [ check 1st person ui for reference]), new ambiance for the main menu, New ambiance for the bridge/wasteland/city, new modulo for weather to make purple fog every four nights instead of every night, New ambiance scares/more to come, content and photo sensitivity warnings, new death screens for juggernaught, smeller, alpha, and mini boss.

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

River now damages whenever it is entered and no longer damages outside of it
Alpha attacks in close proximity no longer have issues


Features:

Death screen added
Juggernaut, Alpha, and Smellers now have finishers
various font changes

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Collectible items respawn on death if not saved prior

Unlockable doors disabling movement bug now fixed

hitting the esc key while the journal index is open will no longer prevent it from closing

Outpost now shows animation sequences and description of what things do

health, stamina, and battery stats are now shown in the objective sheet

Mimics now spawn in the resistance bunkers

notes.title: March 26 2024 update
notes.notes:
Combat:

Dismemberment

New AI called the “Willow” will affect your battery abilities and summon “Swarms” for ranged attacks

Mimics now drop loot on death

Bloaters emit a hallucination effect through their spore cloud

New Gunsmithing tables and tools allow for both the rifle barrels and pistol to be upgraded in various ways

Running with the pistol is now faster than running with the rifle, but slower than running with nothing equipped unless fully upgraded to do so

Mimic Index now shows a kill counter by mimic type

New and improved 3rd person pistol animations including but not limited to: start/stop animations, firing animations, and alert/unalert animations

New spawning logic: mimics on the bridge will only spawn once per day as well as various other locations

New hit reaction animations for Levi

New “Sentry Turret” enemy type 

Remainder of the arm abilities now accessible: electrocute, shield, and stasis


 World:

11 new buildings now accessible in the city including but not limited to: arcade, bar, movie theater, 
gym, and cigar lounge

7 new “Resistance Bunkers” accessible through the wasteland/forest

4 new story progression locations now accessible through the wasteland/forest

3D world map replacing the 2D map that was used previously, also shows goal location, keycode doors, lockboxes, and Player location

Inventory now shows what station parts have been picked up for the beginning of the story

 New world journals and lore placed throughout multiple locations

Expanded tunnels with additional hidden locations and loot placed within

Interactable doors replacing physics simulated doors

Gunsmithing tables and crafting tables are now placed throughout the city and wasteland/forest instead of solely being within the outpost


Other:

Beginning tutorial now provides videos displaying how the mechanics are used

Options menu has additional settings including sensitivity, master volume, immersion mode (disables the hud unless a stat bar is below 50%), and allows the player to review how the mechanics work as well as what their keybinds are.
